args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

3. *Wichita store* (probably Marrow, but not confirmed): you, 2025-07-02 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher. That came up while Tobias was asking about your Zoom hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours, but the message never names the customer, so please check this one.

Not Marrow, in case they catch your eye: the Tulsa hub is Tansley Parcel, and Door 6 / #88412 is Tansleigh Packaging.

Also, Hollis's 2026-06-09 escalation mentions "new stores", and Marrow's tracker screenshot had three rows that just said "waiting". None of those stores are named in the channel, so there may be more sites than these. I only looked in #central-team.
